title: Texas Instruments second-quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Revenue increased 13% sequentially and 23% year over year, with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive.
summary: Texas Instruments reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of USD 5.463 billion, operating profit of USD 2.310 billion, net income of USD 1.980 billion and diluted EPS of USD 2.14. Analog revenue rose 26% and Embedded Processing revenue rose 16%. Trailing-12-month operating cash flow was USD 8.667 billion and company-defined free cash flow was USD 6.534 billion. Third-quarter guidance was USD 5.65-6.15 billion of revenue and USD 2.23-2.57 of EPS.
